campaigns_window_chk.name: campaigns_window_chk
campaigns_window_chk.value: ("send_window_start" GLOB '[01][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' OR "send_window_start" GLOB '2[0-3]:[0-5][0-9]') AND ("send_window_end" GLOB '[01][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' OR "send_window_end" GLOB '2[0-3]:[0-5][0-9]') AND "send_window_start" < "send_window_end"

invitations_accepted_chk.name: invitations_accepted_chk
invitations_accepted_chk.value: ("status" = 'Accepted') = ("accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
